_comment: Idle-speed-friction demo: Unit._current_speed now bleeds off via arrival_brake_rate() instead of snapping to zero the instant a unit stops locomoting with no move/chase target (Battle._physics_process's 'no momentum while stationary' guard, scripts/Unit.gd). A shallow 8-horse Cavalry troop (facing-front actually in spatha reach of a small remnant) charges a brittle 1-man Infantry squad and wipes it; once the last enemy on the field is dead the cavalry has nothing left to chase or march toward, so it goes idle mid-pursuit with real residual speed still on the clock. An 80-horse column's facing-front sits a mounted rank-pitch past a 5-man blob and never finishes the wipe under per-soldier melee, which is why this clip is staged shallow. hold_space + show_unit_speed (session-only, Settings.set_show_unit_speed_session -- never persisted) put the HUD speed label on screen the whole time: it holds near the charge speed through the fight, then visibly counts down over several seconds instead of snapping straight to '0.0 m/s'. drill:true stops Battle._check_victory from pausing the tree once team 1 is wiped out, so the recording keeps running through the whole decay. Deterministic: seed + scripted input + a custom scenario (no default line spawn). Verified by state dump: infantry gone by t950; cavalry IDLE with residual speed ~65 wu/s at t950, decaying to 0 through t1000-1050 while still sliding south.
